model:
rachana: 1
sutra: event-country
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: event-country, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Public sector · World events", id: "$.EVENT_COUNTRY_ID", with: "$.COUNTRY_NAME" }
strip:
  - { label: "Day", bind: "$.DATE", fmt: "date" }
  - { label: "Events", bind: "$.EVENTS", fmt: "amount0", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Mentions", bind: "$.MENTIONS", fmt: "amount0" }
  - { label: "Average tone", bind: "$.AVG_TONE", fmt: "signed2" }
  - { label: "Tone vs window", bind: "$.TONE_CHANGE", fmt: "signed2" }
  - { label: "Goldstein", bind: "$.AVG_GOLDSTEIN", fmt: "signed2" }
  - { label: "Conflict, %", bind: "$.CONFLICT_SHARE", fmt: "price2" }
panels:
  - id: tone
    kind: line
    title: "Average tone by day"
    key: "F2"
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$.HISTORY"
    x: "DATE"
    y: "AVG_TONE"
    fmt: "signed2"
  - id: categories
    kind: hbar
    title: "The day's events by CAMEO category"
    key: "F3"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment", rows: 5 }
    rows: "$.BY_CATEGORY"
    label: "CATEGORY"
    value: "EVENTS"
    fmt: "amount0"
  - id: world
    kind: map
    title: "Average tone by country (a country opens its page)"
    key: "F4"
    height: 11
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment", rows: 5 }
    highlight: "$.ISO3"
    link: { kind: "event-country", id: "GDELT-{iso3}" }
    shade: { kind: "event-country", field: "$.AVG_TONE", by: "$.ISO3", fmt: "signed2", label: "Average tone" }
  - id: stories
    kind: table
    title: "The most-mentioned stories (an address opens the original)"
    key: "F5"
    code: "TOP"
    rows: "$.TOP_STORIES"
    search: false
    columns:
      - { label: "Mentions", bind: "@.MENTIONS", fmt: "amount0" }
      - { label: "Category", bind: "@.CATEGORY" }
      - { label: "Story", bind: "@.URL" }
  - id: source
    kind: kv
    title: "Data source and licence"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "must", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$.PROVENANCE"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
keys: { F9: "raw" }
